content: अव्यापार {%a.%} Having no work, unemployed. .{@-रः@} .²1 Cessation from work, state of being unemployed. .²2 A business not practised or understood. .²3 Not oneʼs own business; अव्यापारेषु व्यापारं {@कृ@} to meddle with affairs not oneʼs own (which do not concern one). <ab>cf.</ab> अव्यापारेषु व्यापारं यो नरः कर्तुमिच्छति <ls>Pt. 1. 21</ls>.
